title: fix(actions): mount the object-less /actions//:action shape; bump objectui to e651c936870e
body:
Closes the #3913/#3962 arc at the HTTP surface, and ships the console halves. Both parts came out of **dogfooding the running showcase app** — the suite was green throughout.

## 1. The object-less action shape was unreachable over HTTP

#3913 taught `handleActionsRequest` to route a single-segment path — `POST /api/v1/actions//:action` — at the canonical `'global'` key. That code was correct and unit-tested, and **nothing ever delivered the path to it**:

- the dispatcher mounts its routes explicitly (no catch-all);
- `:object` does not match an empty path segment;
- no registration covered the `//` form.

So over real HTTP the request fell through to Hono's `notFound` and answered a bare `{"error":"Not found"}` with the actions domain never running — **the exact URL #3913 was filed against still did not dispatch.**

The tests could not see it because they call `dispatcher.handleActions()` / `dispatcher.dispatch()` directly, bypassing the route table. That is precisely the class of bug `dispatcher-plugin.routes.test.ts` was created for, in its own words:

> A `dispatch()` branch with no matching `server.<verb>()` registration is unreachable over HTTP and 404s before reaching the handler — which is exactly how `/mcp` and `/keys` shipped broken (unit tests called the handlers directly, hiding it).

Registered the route and extended that guard to the action shapes. Hono matches the literal `//` and does not shadow `:object/:action` — verified against the router directly before relying on it.

**Before → after** (same server, same call):

```
POST /api/v1/actions//definitely_not_registered
before: 404 {"error":"Not found"}                       ← domain never ran
after:  404 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND",
             "message":"Action '…' on 'global' has no declaration …","httpStatus":404}}
```

Byte-identical to `POST /api/v1/actions/global/definitely_not_registered`. The two-segment route still names its own object (`showcase_task`), unshadowed.

## 2. objectui pin `a136322f8723` → `e651c936870e`

The vendored console was missing the console-side halves of this work:

- objectui#2971 — read #3962's single-wrapped `/actions` responses; PeoplePicker render-phase cursor fix
- objectui#2972 — declared-response-envelope unwrap on the datasource page and the api-action runner

`pnpm objectui:build` run at the new pin; `check:console-sha` green.

## Browser verification (the real console, at the new pin)

| Focus | Result |
|:---|:---|
| Validation-failing action anchors to the field | **400** `error.code: VALIDATION_FAILED`, `error.details.fields[] = [{field:'issued_on', code:'required'}]` |
| A failing action must not show a green toast | **red** `data-type="error"` toast "ValidationError: issued_on is required"; record stayed `Draft` |
| Success is a single wrap | **200** `{success:true, data:{ok:true, id:'…'}}` — `data` IS the handler's return value |
| Success path end-to-end | green toast, record flipped to `Sent`, 会签 approval opened (`In approval · editable`) |
| Deliberate body `throw` | **400** with the clean business message, no sandbox debug wrapper |
| Object-less routing | `/actions/global/:action` and `/actions//:action` now identical |

Screenshots of the red-toast/`Draft` and green-toast/`Sent` states were captured and inspected.

**`resultDialog` / `redirectUrl` risk — checked and closed.** I flagged in objectui#2967 that in-the-wild `resultDialog` paths might have adapted to the old envelope depth. They have not: **every** `resultDialog` in this repo sits on a `type: 'api'` action, which goes through the console's `apiHandler` (single-level unwrap of `/api/…`) — a separate code path from `serverActionHandler`, untouched by the `/actions` depth change. `redirectUrl` has zero producers in-repo, consistent with it never having worked before objectui#2967 fixed the read depth.

**One gap worth noting, not fixed here:** the showcase is the "one specimen of everything" app and has **no object-less (`global`) action**, so that dispatch path has no live specimen to exercise — only routing could be verified end-to-end. Worth a showcase addition in its own PR.

## Testing

- runtime **889** passed (65 files, +1 new case); build green; eslint 0 errors.
- `check:console-sha` in sync at `e651c936870e`.
